proposals.evidence: Dhakal p. 52 prints /kəsike/ “to tighten,” contrasting aspirated /kʰəsike/ “to fall down.” Turner2908 gives Nepali kasnu, Maithili kasab, Hindi kasnā and Gujarati kasvũ “to tighten”; Darai unaspirated kas- selects this family.
